job.title: GM Project Development & Strategy
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is conducting a confidential search for a Perth based engineering, manufacturing and site services specialist, part of a global infrastructure group, appointing a General Manager, Business Development & Strategy. The business is a recognised specialist in operational technology, control systems, electrical engineering and power systems integration, and it self performs the full OT and electrical scope of a project. That vertical integration is the moat. This role is about scaling it.

The mandate is to step up and win packages directly as principal contractor across WA's mining, utility, IPP and industrial capex pipeline, typically in the $10M to $50M range. Switchroom replacements, primary plant upgrades, substation augmentations, BESS balance of plant, microgrid and SAPS rollouts. This is a hunting role first and a strategy role second. You will personally originate and close, and lead the bids that win.

The Opportunity:

  • Personally hunt, qualify and close principal contract opportunities with miners, utilities, IPPs and industrial asset owners
  • Own capture and bid strategy on high value pursuits: bid or no bid gates, competitor analysis, win themes, price to win and risk allocation
  • Convert an established, current WA network into qualified and winnable pipeline, then lead cross functional bid teams to submission
  • An electrical contracting, specialist power or power and energy background is essential, not adjacent industry experience
  • Minimum 15 years across electrical contracting, power systems, switchroom manufacturing, OT or SCADA or electrical EPC delivery, with at least 10 years in BD, capture, presales or bid leadership
  • Demonstrable principal contract capture at $5M plus package scale, where you led the bid strategy and closure yourself, alongside divisional P&L or pipeline target ownership

job.title: GM Power Solutions
job.description:
PARTNER Executive has been retained to find the founding General Manager of a new Power Solutions division within a Perth-based engineering, manufacturing and site services business. The mandate: enter the WA energy storage market, substations, BESS and stand-alone power systems, with board-level backing, approved budget and a clearly defined strategy. This is a genuine greenfield build, and a career-defining opportunity for the right leader.

The Opportunity:

  • Founding leader of a new division: own the P&L from inception, build the team, establish the market presence and deliver the first projects.
  • Ride the WA energy transition: a rapidly growing storage market backed by billions in state renewable commitments and active utility procurement programs.
  • Leverage a vertically integrated platform, engineering, manufacturing and site services, to deliver turnkey solutions, with sister companies in the group for joint bidding on larger opportunities.
  • Your background: 10+ years in power, energy or renewables in Australia, with senior leadership experience and delivery across substation, HV, BESS, SAPS, microgrid or similar distributed energy projects.
  • An established WA energy sector network is essential, utilities, Tier 1 miners or IPPs.
  • Suited to an entrepreneurial, hands-on builder: someone willing to write the first bid, visit the first site and commission the first unit, then scale the team around them.

job.title: Mine Manager
job.description:
PARTNER Executive has been engaged to conduct a search for a Mining Manager with a leading mining company. This is a residential leadership role based in regional WA, a senior operational seat offering the scale, systems and career pathways that only a global major can provide.

To be clear on what we're looking for: this is a role for a proven Mining Manager, not a step up. You will have held the seat before, at scale, and have the operational depth and leadership maturity that comes with running large, complex mining operations.

The Opportunity:

  • A senior residential leadership role in regional WA, build your career and your lifestyle in the same place.
  • Accountability for safe, efficient mining operations at a large-scale site.
  • Lead, coach and develop large multidisciplinary teams, with a strong focus on safety culture and operational discipline.
  • Your background: demonstrated experience as a Mining Manager on large mine sites, this is not a development opportunity for an aspiring leader.
  • Relevant WA statutory certification highly regarded.
  • A confidential process, all enquiries handled with complete discretion.

job.title: Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is delighted to be partnering with a successful, privately owned property investment and management group on the appointment of its first Chief Financial Officer. With an established portfolio anchored in shopping centres and retail assets, the business is entering an exciting new chapter, and this appointment will play a central role in shaping its future direction.

As the inaugural CFO, you will work closely with the owners and leadership team, providing financial and commercial leadership across the portfolio and building the finance function to support the group's continued growth. This is a genuinely strategic role, well beyond the numbers.

The Opportunity:

  • A first-of-its-kind appointment: the business's inaugural CFO, with real scope to build and shape the finance function from the ground up.
  • Strategic influence: partner directly with the owners on investment decisions, portfolio strategy and growth planning.
  • Broad commercial remit across an established portfolio of shopping centres and retail property assets.
  • Drive financial leadership: reporting, capital management, funding and performance across the group.
  • A strong property background is essential, with shopping centre / retail asset experience highly regarded.
  • Suited to a commercially astute, hands-on finance leader who wants genuine ownership of their function and a seat at the table.

job.title: Business Development Manager Queensland
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is pleased to be supporting one of Australia's fastest growing lubricant wholesale businesses in the search for a Business Development Manager based in Queensland. As the exclusive regional partner of one of the world's largest petrochemical companies, our client has built a strong national reputation as a premium supplier to B2B customers, with service and support at the centre of its offer.

This role is all about growth: identifying new customers, winning tenders and building lasting relationships across Queensland. Critically, we're looking for someone with a genuine, established network across the mining and resources sector, the relationships and credibility to open doors from day one.

The Opportunity:

  • Own new business development across QLD for a fast-growing national supplier with a premium product offering.
  • A strong mining and resources network is essential: this role will live and breathe the sector, and your existing relationships will be key to success.
  • Full sales cycle ownership: prospecting, proposals, tenders and pricing through to conversion and account growth.
  • Genuine autonomy: operate independently with the backing of a national sales team and leadership that trusts you to run your patch.
  • Brisbane-based with travel as required.
  • Suited to an experienced, proficient negotiator who is self-driven, commercially sharp and thrives on hunting new business.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is pleased to be supporting our client in the search for a senior Construction Project Manager to take full ownership of a major remote project valued at $80M+. This is a genuine project leadership appointment, not a coordinator-style role, for someone with the instincts, presence and commercial sharpness to drive a sophisticated, multi-front project with confidence.

This is a demanding environment: multiple concurrent work fronts, staged construction, significant refurbishment within an operating facility, live operational interfaces, and sophisticated client and consultant stakeholders, backed by a large volume of externally developed architectural and engineering documentation. Sequencing, planning, interfaces and responsiveness are everything, and the successful candidate will effectively live in the programme.

The Opportunity:

  • Take complete ownership of delivery, safety, quality, schedule, cost and team morale on a single, fully dedicated $80M+ remote project.
  • Lead a full, properly resourced project team, Project Engineers, Project Controllers, Schedulers, QA and HSE personnel, Supervisors, multiple Site Managers, Contract Administration support and a Commercial Manager.
  • Drive programme development, sequencing and schedule management across multiple simultaneous work fronts.
  • Operate at a sophisticated level of client and stakeholder management, with strong commercial control and awareness throughout.
  • Perth-based, with regular multi-day site visits each fortnight.
  • Suited to a confident, composed leader with 10+ years' construction experience, strong commercial acumen, and a proven track record delivering large, complex, highly coordinated projects, backgrounds in remote/mining infrastructure, accommodation villages, industrial, defence or sophisticated commercial construction all welcome.

job.title: Operations Manager (2IC) - Tom Price
job.description:
PARTNER Executive has been engaged to find an Operations Manager for a busy mining and civil contractor with deep roots in WA's North West. Based residentially in Tom Price, this is a true 2IC position, the right hand to senior leadership, with real ownership of day-to-day operations across a diverse portfolio of civil and mining works.

Opportunities to live and lead in the Pilbara at this level don't come up often. This one will suit a civil construction operator who's ready to take the step up and make the role their own.

The Opportunity:

  • A genuine 2IC role: broad operational responsibility with a clear leadership mandate across projects, people and performance.
  • Residential position based in Tom Price, a rare opportunity to build a senior career in the Pilbara without the FIFO lifestyle.
  • Drive day-to-day delivery across civil and mining works for major clients in one of Australia's most active resources regions.
  • A senior seat in a well-established contracting business with a strong regional presence.
  • Your background: civil construction, with proven experience leading operations, teams and subcontractors in demanding project environments.
  • Suited to a hands-on, commercially aware leader who thrives on accountability and building strong site cultures.
  • Fully subsidised housing and relocation is provided

job.title: Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is proud to be supporting an ASX-listed gold development company on the search for a Chief Financial Officer. With a flagship, large-scale asset in one of the world's premier gold producing regions, a landmark strategic funding agreement recently secured, and a strong balance sheet, our client is transitioning from development through to project execution and, ultimately, operations.

Reporting to the Managing Director, the CFO will act as a key strategic partner to the MD and Board, providing commercial and financial leadership across funding strategy, capital management, project development and operational readiness.

The Opportunity:

  • Lead the Company's funding strategy: engage directly with banks, investors and financial institutions as the business progresses toward development and construction.
  • A genuine seat at the table: partner with the Managing Director and Board on strategic decision-making at a pivotal stage of growth.
  • Broad commercial scope: critical insight across budgeting, forecasting, capital allocation and project economics, working closely with corporate and technical teams.
  • Build for scale: shape finance and IT capability, and strengthen reporting, governance and risk frameworks as the business grows.
  • Resources sector experience essential: exposure to both project development and operational environments, with hands-on industry experience (not solely advisory or banking). Gold and/or copper experience highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated involvement in debt funding processes will be key, with the ability to support or lead lender and investor engagement.
